# A recorded shell (pts/2, held by its cinelog recorder) runs a tmux client; the tmux
# server holds the pane masters pts/5 and pts/6. Each pane gets its own cast.
self 500
user 1000 alice
boot 0f4b8c2e-1111-4222-8333-444455556666

proc pid=1 ppid=0 uid=0 comm=systemd exe=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd
proc pid=100 comm=alacritty exe=/usr/bin/alacritty ptmx=20:1
proc pid=110 ppid=100 comm=cinelog exe=/home/alice/.zim/modules/cinelog/bin/cinelog args=zsh tty=pts/1 ptmx=5:2 start=11000
proc pid=120 ppid=110 comm=zsh exe=/usr/bin/zsh tty=pts/2 tpgid=130
proc pid=130 ppid=120 comm="tmux: client" exe=/usr/bin/tmux args=tmux|attach tty=pts/2 tpgid=130
proc pid=400 comm="tmux: server" exe=/usr/bin/tmux args="tmux: server (/tmp/tmux-1000/default)" ptmx=7:5,9:6 sid=400
proc pid=500 ppid=400 comm=zsh exe=/usr/bin/zsh tty=pts/5 tpgid=500
proc pid=510 ppid=400 comm=zsh exe=/usr/bin/zsh tty=pts/6 tpgid=510
registry pts=2 pid=110 uuid=01930a3e-0000-7000-8000-0000000000aa

expect check tty=pts:5 start=500 euid=1000 => start personal tmux-server
expect check tty=pts:6 start=510 euid=1000 => start personal tmux-server
expect holder pts=5 start=500 => pid=400 via=ancestor class=multiplexer comm="tmux: server"
# the outer shell is already recorded by our recorder
expect check tty=pts:2 start=120 euid=1000 => recorded 01930a3e-0000-7000-8000-0000000000aa
expect holder pts=2 start=120 => pid=110 via=ancestor class=own-same
expect valid pts=2 => true
# the outer recorder pauses while the tmux client is in the foreground
expect foreground fg=130 shell=120 => multiplexer pid=130 comm="tmux: client"
expect foreground fg=120 shell=120 => shell
# the alacritty tab itself
expect check tty=pts:1 start=110 euid=1000 => start personal terminal
